items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: Interviewer mentions Neil Hefti as being on the same bill: '...with Duke Ellington, with Neil Hefti, with Charlie Parker...'

ctx.x: It must have gone over very big in '49 for Norman Granz to put you on that February 11, 1949 bill, with Duke Ellington, with Neil Hefti, with Charlie Parker, with a few other well-knowns whose names escape me now. Lester Young was on that. Now, this is the time that you played "Tanga" at Carnegie Hall and it came out on that album, "The Jazz Scene". Do you recall that day?
Yeah, I have to remember one of the greatest
